Outstanding food and service
Feb 2026 • Couples
We were walking past and decided on an early dinner. Sat outside and watched the world go by. Started with beef empanada and spicy Argentinian sausages, both excellent. Then burrata salad and Greek salad, incredible quality cheeses in both. BF finished with a black angus filet with sides of sautéd broccoli and baked potato. I was too full already for a main course as they had also given us delicious bread and chimichurri with our starters. Somehow managed 2 bottles of Argentinian red wine as well! Excellent meal, excellent service, not cheap but worth it. Highly recommend.

Nice atmosphere and great service
Nov 2024 • Couples
We had an enjoyable evening and a very good meal here. Originally, we planned to dine at the location near the opera house, but it was fully booked, so we took a Grab to this venue instead.

The welcome was warm, and the service was attentive, though the restaurant seemed overstaffed for the number of tables. This led to staff frequently crossing paths, and we noticed several orders being delivered to the wrong tables. Despite this, the team’s attentiveness was commendable.

The food overall was good, and we particularly enjoyed the sides. We ordered the Wagyu ribeye (American cut) but found it to be thinner than expected and lacking seasoning. While it was cooked well, it fell short of expectations, especially as we are accustomed to top-quality steaks in New Zealand. For its price, it didn’t quite meet the mark.

That said, the service and ambience were excellent, and we left the restaurant happy with our experience.

We all fancied a steak night! Recommend this place
Mar 2024 • Couples
We asked our concierge to recommend a steak house close by, El Gaucho Le Loi was his recommendation, so we asked him to reserve us a table
It was busy on arrival, but enough room for either indoor or outside dining, we opted for indoor as was rather warm out and being in the city a fair bit of traffic
The steak options were amazing, almost too much to choose. We decided to go with the bare minimum grade 9oz fillet steak with fries, it was awesome. We do eat a fair bit of steak and would know a good bit from a poor bit and this was as good as any we have ever had. Would have been gutted to have paid twice the price, no matter how 'better' it would have been :) I always try and have 10oz at home as less not enough and more is just greedy. I am sure it was more than 9oz as the 3 of us that had it were well stuffed. One had the burger (proper chef one) and she thought that was great too. I believe it was a Mr Sebastien that was looking after us, but there also was a young lady assisting us. Both great hosts so thanks to them and to the chef(s). On leaving we handed over the card our hotel Concierge had given us to provide them with we assumed said get them a taxi to there. The young lady that sorted that was out on the street on her phone getting it done, nothing was too much trouble
